title: A.E. Convergence vs Boundedness
summary: We extend Stein's maximal theorem to the bilinear setting. Let $M$ be a homogeneous space with a transitive action of a compact abelian group, and let $1 \le p,q \le 2$ and $1/2 \le r \le 1$ satisfy $1/p + 1/q = 1/r$. For a family of translation-invariant bilinear operators \[ T_m : L^p(M) \times L^q(M) \to L^r(M), \qquad m \in \mathbb{N}, \] that converge almost everywhere, we prove that the associated maximal operator \[ T^*(f,g) = \sup_m |T_m(f,g)| \] is of weak type $L^p(M) \times L^q(M) \to L^{r,\infty}(M)$.
